app.title: Replit: Vibe Code with AI Fast
app.text:
Describe what you want. Replit builds it — websites, web apps, slides, videos, data dashboards, and more.

No coding. No tools to learn. Just describe what you need in plain language, and Replit handles the building, testing, debugging, and hosting — all in one place. It's like having an entire team of engineers and designers on demand, available through a simple chat.

Trusted by 50 million creators and builders worldwide.

BUILD ANYTHING

One platform for everything you want to make:

- Web apps — live in minutes with a public URL
- Websites and prototypes
- Slide decks and presentations

results.trackName: Replit: Vibe Code with AI Fast
results.title: Still Frustrated — and My Previous Review Disappeared
results.body: I’m posting this again because the review I previously left is no longer showing, and I have no idea why. I’ve spent a significant amount of money using Replit to build my app, and the experience has become extremely frustrating. I’ve had an Expo Launch issue blocking my App Store submission for more than a week. Replit support has already confirmed the problem is on their side, but I’ve still had to follow up repeatedly, explain the same issue over and over, and wait while nothing gets resolved. I also went 9 days without even using the app while this issue was unresolved, and I was still charged during that time. Then right after those 9 days, I was charged the roughly $20 subscription fee plus another random charge of more than $40. That was especially frustrating when I wasn’t even able to use the platform to move my app forward because of their own publishing issue. I was told the issue was under review and that support would follow up, then later I was contacted as if they were waiting on me. I’ve also had account confusion involving an Apple private relay email and generated username, which made support and billing even more frustrating. Meanwhile, I’m still being charged while I’m unable to move forward because of a problem I cannot fix myself. I’ve put a lot of time, money, and effort into this app, and I’m stuck because of Replit’s publishing setup and poor support follow-through. The fact that my previous review is no longer visible only adds to the frustration. I’m documenting my actual experience with the platform, billing, and support process.

results.trackName: Replit: Vibe Code with AI Fast
results.title: Great at First, but Now Expensive and Frustrating
results.body: Replit was one of the best AI platforms for building apps and websites when I first started using it. However, after more than a year—and especially with Agents 5 and 6—the experience has gone downhill. Debugging issues get stuck in loops, instructions are often not implemented correctly the first time, and I sometimes have to repeat the same request two or three times and republish the project multiple times just to get what I originally asked for. The agent is also much slower, which burns through credits and makes every project more expensive. Some issues have taken nearly 24 hours to debug. I have been charged as much as $250 in a single day and then had to purchase another $100 in credits just to keep working. When I contacted customer service, they focused on explaining agent fees instead of addressing why the agent was repeatedly failing, looping, and using so many credits. Replit still has great potential, but customers should not be charged for repeated attempts caused by the agent failing to follow instructions or fix problems correctly. Billing needs to be more transparent, failed agent runs should be reviewed and credited, and customer service needs to offer real solutions.
